mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a backyard sauna in Markham?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessory building over 10 m² (about 107 sq ft) typically needs a building permit in Ontario, and zoning setbacks apply to every structure. The electrical connection needs an ESA permit. We'll check your model against Markham's rules before you order.

mainEntity.name: I live in Unionville's heritage district. Can I still add a sauna?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, yes. Heritage districts focus on what's visible from the street. If your sauna will be visible, we can provide drawings and photos for the town's review.

mainEntity.name: Can my Markham sauna have a wood stove?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, on our larger models like the Neptune and Avalon, which have the space for a wood stove's clearances. Check your home insurer's requirements before choosing wood.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in Markham?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including Markham. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
